import csv,re
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('objects-01-advanced.p01.csv')))
def parse(sop):
    ids={}
    refs=set()
    for line in sop.splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        m=re.match(r'@(\w+)\s+(\S+)(.*)$',line)
        assert m, line
        wid,typ,rest=m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3)
        ids[wid]=(typ,rest)
        for r in re.findall(r'\$(\w+)',rest): refs.add(r)
    return ids,refs
for r in rows:
    ids,refs=parse(r['sop'])
    orph=[k for k in ids if k not in refs]
    # report orphans that are not clauses
    o=[k for k in orph if ids[k][0]!='syntax.clause']
    if o:
        print(r['n'], r['text'])
        for k in o: print('   ',k,ids[k][0],ids[k][1])
EOF
